escalation_reason: Antivirus/endpoint security flagging a fresh uv release; per playbook, treat as likely vendor false positive but escalate as a security-adjacent report. Reporter's version numbers (11.8/11.9) look like typos for 0.11.x.
rationale: Reporter says Trellix ES blocks uv*.exe from versions after 0.11.8; no uv error or logs. Root cause is the corporate endpoint security product, not uv, so likely external; nothing for a maintainer to act on in uv beyond suggesting allowlisting or reporting a false positive to the vendor. Searches found no Trellix-specific issue, only the related antivirus false-positive reports #17344 and #1587, which are different products and not exact duplicates.
